# IndianTimers - LLM Reference Guide

> IndianTimers is a specialized Indian examination countdown, schedule tracking, and student productivity platform.

## Key Sections & APIs
- Homepage: https://indiantimers.com/
- Searchable Exam Directory: https://indiantimers.com/exams/
- 2027 Master Exam Calendar: https://indiantimers.com/calendar/2027/
- Pomodoro Focus Timer: https://indiantimers.com/tools/pomodoro-timer/
- Mock Test Simulation Timer: https://indiantimers.com/tools/mock-test-timer/
- Precision Stopwatch: https://indiantimers.com/tools/stopwatch/
- Custom Countdown Generator: https://indiantimers.com/tools/countdown/
- Editorial Guides & Preparation Strategy: https://indiantimers.com/blog/

## Data Methodology
- Examination dates are audited against conducting authority circulars (NTA, UPSC, IITs, CBSE, IIMs).
- Statuses are strictly classified: Official Confirmed, Tentative (Official Calendar), Expected, Date Not Announced.
